title: P15.9 owner-action HTTP/UI seams + P16-A Brain Context Aggregator (R1 repair)
description: Step 0 (P15.9): owner POST routes /api/vnext/objectives/:id/{progress,evidence,amend}. Authority is ONLY the x-operator-id header via canonicalOperatorActor/operatorRef — coercion artifacts (empty/undefined/null/[object Object]/NaN/Infinity) rejected at the objective-create mint edge AND every owner-scoped actor edge, so no operator:undefined owner can be minted or claimed (H5/H6). Body operator_id/verifier/actor never substitutes (H3); evidence verifier is always the header actor; evidence_key required; source pinned owner-console; value typeof-strict finite (H4). amend rejects zero-key patches at the canonical service layer. accountBudget stays unexposed (cost-pipeline seam). FAIL_CLOSED_OBJECTIVE_UNVERIFIED/SCOPE/BRAIN_* map to 403. UI: diff-only amendments, strict numeric/date entry, REVOKED tone, exact-body retry. Step 1 (P16-A): brain-context.ts contextFor — owner-gated strict read-only aggregation over ObjectiveCockpitService (payload+event hash footprint identical — B7). Deterministic context_digest pins canonical state only: asof + clock-derived status fields (expiry_pending/effective/reasons) excluded from digest input — expiry instant cannot fake a state change (B1/B1b). KPI/budget re-proven directly — binding absence reports BINDING_ABSENT, never false UNPROVEN notes (B1d); only classified terminal-grant end degrades. Bounded withReadBudget; nested outer budget fails closed FAIL_CLOSED_BRAIN_BUDGET (B1c); PROOF_LIMIT typed (B6). Unscoped memory/experience report SCOPE_BINDING_ABSENT (P17 prerequisite). Tamper propagates (B2); broken CAS drops+reports (B4); business isolation (B5). Library-only — no Brain wiring. R1 repair of reviewer M1 (identity), M2 (digest), M3 (HTTP coverage) + minors.
